author: nflaig
content: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/643 let's get this merged soon then unless someone speaks up today, we don't wanna implement this api if no one is using it, it's also non trivial to implement this as it assumes the beacon node has prepared a payload for this bid, and all builder implementations that exists today construct the unsigned bid outside the beacon node

author: stefanbratanov
content: I don't have a strong preference, but isn't a consumer potentially a feature in a CL that can be configured to be a builder as well as validator and publish signed bids on gossip with its local payload (I don't think any CL has implemented that)

author: nflaig
content: yeah but we miss a few other apis to make that work e2e, we looked at implementing this in lodestar and it's too complex/less flexible vs. constructing this outside the bn and having builder talk to engine api (or other builder like rbuilder) directly

author: nflaig
content: given the current state that nobody implemented this at this point, not sure it can be relied upon for gloas, handing out a unsigned bid also assumes that you can serve the payload later, which might be non trivial for all clients to implement
